title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 Littered With AI-Made Cosmetics; With One Operator Equipped With 5 Pistols
key_facts: Electronic Arts and Battlefield Studios released Season 5 of Battlefield 6 'earlier today' (article published 13 Oct 2026).
The new Battle Pass brings new cosmetics and items to earn.
MP1st says some of the rewards are 'clearly created by AI'.
One operator (player character) skin has five handguns of the same kind decorated around the character.
Another skin has 'Secuty' written on the sleeve instead of 'Security'.
Community member DemidRomanov pointed out that a 'Drawing Dead' weapon charm looks AI-made and listed what AI got wrong.
EA also announced a Battlefield 6 Game of the Year Edition.
quote_evidence: First off is an operator skin available in the Battle Pass that hilariously has five handguns (of the same kind!) decorated around the character
there’s also another skin that has “Secuty” written on the sleeve instead of, y’know, Security.
why_it_matters_hint: Visible mistakes in game items feed the debate over AI-made art in games.
notes: Full text read. The AI claim rests on how the items look; the article quotes no EA statement. The writer's own remark says four handguns in one place and five in another; the entry follows the headline and first mention (five).
